sources.title: Ink Business Cash® Credit Card | Chase
Ink Business Cash Pricing & Terms (fetch blocked by robots.txt on 2026-10-28; not read)

benefits.name: New cardmember bonus: $750 cash back
benefits.period_note: Earn $750 cash back after spending $6,000 on purchases in the first 3 months after account opening. Bonus posts 6 to 8 weeks after qualifying. Offer visible on the issuer page 2026-10-28; offers change over time, and the offer that applies to a given account is the one in effect at approval.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Spend $6,000 on purchases within 3 months of account opening. Page states the bonus may be unavailable to applicants who have ever had this card or any Chase for Business card with no annual fee. Awarded as 75,000 points (1 cash back dollar = 100 points).

benefits.name: Employee cards at no additional cost
benefits.period_note: Employee cards are offered at no additional cost for the life of the account.
benefits.enrollment_note: Request employee cards through Chase; individual spending limits can be set per employee card.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Authorized users have equal charging privileges unless individual spending limits are set. The Authorizing Officer and the business are responsible for all account use and balances. The page does not state a maximum number of employee cards.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.period_note: Covers eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase (90 days for New York residents). Up to $10,000 per item. The product page does not state a per-account annual maximum.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Eligible new purchases made with the card, against damage or theft.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28. Per-item cap recorded; per-account cap not stated on the page.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.period_note: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of three years or less by one additional year, up to four years from the purchase date.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Eligible items purchased with the card that carry a U.S. manufacturer warranty of three years or less.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28. The product page does not state a dollar cap for this benefit.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver (primary for business rentals)
benefits.period_note: Per rental. Coverage is primary when renting for business purposes.
benefits.enrollment_note: Decline the rental company's collision insurance and charge the entire rental to the card.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Reimburses up to $60,000 for theft and collision damage on most rental vehicles with an MSRP of $125,000 or less. Primary when renting for business purposes.

benefits.name: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Legal and medical referrals and other travel and emergency assistance. The cardmember pays for any goods or services obtained.

benefits.name: Roadside Dispatch
benefits.period_note: Pay-per-use dispatch service; service fees are billed to the card at dispatch.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Call the provider to dispatch roadside help. Not a free service; fees are charged to the card.

benefits.name: 0% intro APR on purchases for 12 months
benefits.period_note: 0% intro APR for 12 months from account opening on purchases; a variable APR applies afterward.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Purchases only. Post-intro variable APR ranges shown on the page on 2026-10-28 were 16.99% to 29.99% and 24.99% to 29.99% depending on the rate range assigned.

benefits.name: Instacart+ membership (3 months) and $20 monthly Instacart credit
benefits.period_note: Complimentary three-month Instacart+ membership; activated members get a $20 monthly Instacart credit. Benefit ends 2027-12-31. The page does not say whether unused credit rolls over.
benefits.enrollment_note: Requires enrollment/activation of Instacart+ with the card. Membership auto-renews at $99 per year after the complimentary period unless canceled.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Instacart purchases while the Instacart+ membership is active and paid with the card.
